aggressive_definition: Fatal prostate cancer occurring during follow-up of an initially cancer-free prospective cohort.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: Comparing men in the top with men in the bottom tertile of serum calcium, the multivariable-adjusted relative hazard for fatal prostate cancer was 2.68 (95% confidence interval, 1.02-6.99; P(trend) = 0.04).
study_design: Prospective cohort using NHANES and the NHANES Epidemiologic Follow-up Study.
reason: Serum calcium was measured before diagnosis in a prospective cohort. The study analyzed both overall incident prostate cancer and fatal prostate cancer risk; the latter is a lethal incident endpoint rather than a postdiagnosis survival analysis.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: For incident prostate cancer, the relative risk for the same comparison was 1.31 (95% confidence interval, 0.77-2.20; P(trend) = 0.34).
estimate_classifications.reason: The abstract explicitly assigns this estimate to overall incident prostate cancer.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Comparing men in the top with men in the bottom tertile of serum calcium, the multivariable-adjusted relative hazard for fatal prostate cancer was 2.68 (95% confidence interval, 1.02-6.99; P(trend) = 0.04).
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate is explicitly for fatal prostate cancer arising during prospective follow-up, which qualifies as lethal incident disease.
